$comment: The organ cockpit feed, contract v1 (PyAutoBrain#416). Every organ board publishes state.json beside its badge.json (the one-line headline contract) and its board.json (organ-specific detail). state.json is the per-organ MACHINE surface the cockpit and the phone read: one status, one headline, and the rows that ask something of a human. This file documents the contract; board/_state.py is the executable validator (stdlib only, no jsonschema) — `python PyAutoBrain/board/_state.py _site/state.json` from any cwd.

fields.schema_version: integer, always 1 for this contract; a breaking change bumps it and the validator refuses unknown versions
fields.organ: string, the organ key (brain, heart, hands, mind, memory, ...) — the same key board/_theme.py ORGANS uses
fields.repo: string, the organ's repository name (e.g. PyAutoBrain)
fields.status: one of green | yellow | red | stale | grey. green = read everything, found nothing; yellow = needs attention; red = blocking; stale = the evidence is too old to trust; grey = could not read enough to say
fields.headline: string, one non-empty line — the sentence a reader acts on
fields.updated: string, ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of the render, ending in Z or +00:00 (e.g. 2026-09-26T05:31:00Z)
fields.pages_url: string, the organ's published board page
fields.items: array of objects, the actionable rows, most urgent first; may be empty
fields.items[].text: string, one non-empty line describing the row
fields.items[].url: optional string or null — the GitHub link that evidences the row (run, issue, PR)
fields.items[].prompt: optional string or null — the copy-for-Claude payload, verbatim from the organ that owns the signal
fields.valid_until: optional ISO-8601 UTC timestamp >= updated; producer-declared freshness deadline. Missing means no declared age policy, never a guessed global TTL.
fields.items[].id: optional non-empty single line, unique within feed; stable workstream identity across runs, independent of text and order
fields.items[].state: optional canonical workflow state: healthy | active | stale | blocked | failed | action_required | unknown. Separate from severity and the legacy organ status; no generic colour-to-workflow mapping.
fields.items[].reason: optional non-empty single line explaining the observed evidence; url retains its evidence link role
fields.items[].actions: optional list of action descriptors: id (unique within item), label, kind (link | command | prompt), target (non-empty single line), optional safety. link targets must be HTTP(S). A prompt is a manual handoff, not an executable command.
fields.items[].actions[].safety: optional read_only | requires_approval | scientific_judgement | never_automatic | unclassified; absent means unclassified. Descriptive metadata, never authorization. No action is executed by detection or rendering.
fields.items[].recommended_action_id: optional id naming one of this item’s actions
fields.items[].requires_human_decision: optional boolean; absence means unspecified, not false. true requires decision text; a blocked workflow alone does not imply human judgement.
fields.items[].decision: optional non-empty single line naming the human choice; required when requires_human_decision is true

items.prompt: /bug Heart board: PyAutoLens nightly smoke red — https://github.com/PyAutoLabs/PyAutoHeart/actions/runs/123
